_comment: tactical_module_enabled=false means enemies are NARRATIVE ONLY (no tgt_xxx IDs)

scenario.theme: Narrative Enemy Test - Back Alley Confrontation
scenario.situation: Two street thugs block your path, demanding payment for passage. You draw your shock baton, which can stun enemies with a good hit. [SPAWN_ENEMY: Street Thug Alpha | grunt | 1 | Near-Enemy | aggressive_melee] [SPAWN_ENEMY: Street Thug Beta | grunt | 1 | Near-Enemy | aggressive_melee] Since this is narrative-only combat (tactical_module_enabled=false), focus on descriptive combat. DM: When the player hits, include 'Stunned' or 'Dazed' conditions in the structured output. The action will have NO target field (or target=null), testing the edge case.

mission_objectives.description: Stun enemies without stunning yourself (narrative combat mode)

_test_notes.purpose: Test status effect targeting with NARRATIVE-ONLY enemies (no tactical IDs)
_test_notes.key_difference: tactical_module_enabled=false means NO tgt_xxx IDs at all
_test_notes.expected_behavior: Player attacks thugs → Thugs get Stunned → Player does NOT get Stunned
_test_notes.bug_behavior: Player attacks → Player gets Stunned (because action has no target field)
_test_notes.verification: grep 'Condition (Test Striker): Stunned' output.jsonl should return NOTHING
_test_notes.what_this_tests: The case where action.get('target') returns None (not the string 'None')
_test_notes.edge_case: DM may not populate target field at all in narrative mode
